---
description: "Generate a security audit report from scan results"
mode: "agent"
agent: "security-reporter"
---

Generate a complete security audit report from the scan results:

1. Read the scan results from `audit-results/scan-results.md`
2. Generate the full audit report at `audit-results/audit-report.md`
3. Generate an executive summary at `audit-results/executive-summary.md`
4. Generate individual finding reports for Critical and High severity issues in `audit-results/findings/`

Use the MCP report templates — do not create formats from scratch.
